images.caption: Figure 1:Overview ofKernelZero, a co-evolution framework for kernel generation. The system consists of two models with explicit interfaces: aProposerthat takes a set of Torch APIs as input and generates a runnable Torch module, and aCoderthat translates the module into an optimized CUDA or Triton kernel.
